essence: Despite prior learning, the speaker requests additional instruction at this moment.
The forthcoming instruction requires focused attention and careful retention.
The knowledge being revealed grants complete sovereignty to its possessor.
A mortal who recites and retains this knowledge gains sovereignty over the three worlds.
The mantra's ritual framework identifies Virāṭ as its meter and Bhuvaneśvarī as its deity.
